activities.name: Travelling in the harmattan
activities.note: nothing closes; the harmattan is the dry season, and it is what makes the roads passable — the trade-off is the dust

windows.reason: the haziest weeks: dust off the Sahara cuts visibility sharply, and humidity drops far enough to be uncomfortable
the harmattan runs from late November to mid-March — dry, cool mornings and hazy skies, and the peak of the West African dry season

activities.name: FESPACO film festival, Ouagadougou
activities.note: Africa's biggest film festival is biennial: it runs only in odd-numbered years

windows.reason: held in odd-numbered years, opening on the last Saturday of February and running into early March

activities.name: Semaine nationale de la culture, Bobo-Dioulasso
activities.note: a biennial culture week; the regional heats run in the off years

windows.reason: the national final is held in Bobo-Dioulasso every second year, recently between late March and early May

activities.name: Karfiguéla falls, near Banfora
activities.note: the cascades lie 12 km north-west of Banfora

windows.reason: the rainy season, June to September, is when the falls run at their fullest
